issues.title: Feature request: Inflate the highlighted result to make it easier to find at a large scale.
issues.evidence: Chart search now has an explicit Zoom to match action for the selected retained result, restoring useful magnification after panning/zooming out. issues.title: Feature request: Enhance search syntax, such as whole-word matching and regular expression search.
issues.evidence: Substring, Unicode whole-word and exact name/path search are implemented. Matchers are compiled once per query and file-only matches avoid highlight-range allocations. issues.remaining: Whole-word and exact literal modes are implemented. Arbitrary regular expressions still require bounded execution and cancellation to prevent pathological patterns freezing large searches.

issues.title: [Bug] Chrome crashes with "Out of Memory" error when viewing large profiles (~375MB)
issues.evidence: Cancellable streaming duration imports now frame one bounded event at a time for native JSON parsing, keeping byte/event/depth guards and format fallbacks. Three fresh-process PLC comparisons reduced median import time from 4336 to 2493 ms and median peak RSS from 613 to 579 MiB. Export equality verified; general out-of-core storage/rendering and original OOM cases remain open. Complete-event queues now reuse original begin events and retain compact end records; already chronological queues avoid sort workspace. Selected-stack details render at most 100 ancestors per page. Graph search now retains at most 10,000 navigation matches, 4,096 boolean frame results and 512 labels with at most 64 ranges each; truncation is explicit and matching continues outside the navigation window. Sandwich now uses fixed-height count/size geometry instead of per-frame size objects or a frame-index Map. Viewport arithmetic is constant time; repeated/adjacent/wrap selection lookup is cached, with one scan for unrelated selections. Resize/filter clamping is tested. Inputs of at least 1 MiB now use generic worker routing regardless of filename extension, covering perf/folded/pprof/JFR/Android/ZIP and renamed captures when workers are available. DOM-dependent/CSP-blocked fallback can still run on the main thread; generic imports are not made streaming by this routing. UTF-8 perf/folded text now streams plain/native-gzip File and buffer inputs through shared incremental parsers, including compressed inputs below the worker threshold. Expanded byte, line, perf-event, depth and sample limits bound temporary input state; yielding permits main-thread cancellation. Fixture export equality covers existing perf/folded inputs and deep stacks.
issues.remaining: Final profile models, worker snapshots, remaining generic full-input formats, sorting, geometry and full frame arrays still scale with the capture. Native-gzip streaming needs DecompressionStream; unsupported encodings/formats retain generic fallback. General out-of-core viewing and original OOM reproductions remain incomplete.

Viewport arithmetic is constant time; repeated/adjacent/wrap selection lookup is cached, with one scan for unrelated selections. Resize/filter clamping is tested. UTF-8 perf/folded text now streams plain/native-gzip File and buffer inputs through shared incremental parsers, including compressed inputs below the worker threshold. Fixture export equality covers existing perf/folded inputs and deep stacks.
